question: For trips where 'Clay St & Drumm St' occurs before 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the stop sequence (one direction only), what are the earliest departure times from 'Clay St & Drumm St' and the latest arrival times at 'Sacramento St & Davis St' in the format HH:MM:SS? Please provide the trip headsign for each route.
sql:
SELECT 
  t.route_id,
  t.trip_headsign,
  MIN(CASE WHEN st_clay.stop_id = 14015 THEN st_clay.departure_time END) AS earliest_departure_clay,
  MAX(CASE WHEN st_sac.stop_id = 16294 THEN st_sac.arrival_time END) AS latest_arrival_sac
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.trips` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st_clay ON CAST(t.trip_id AS INT64) = st_clay.trip_id AND st_clay.stop_id = 14015
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_transit_muni.stop_times` st_sac ON CAST(t.trip_id AS INT64) = st_sac.trip_id AND st_sac.stop_id = 16294
WHERE st_clay.stop_sequence < st_sac.stop_sequence
GROUP BY t.route_id, t.trip_headsign
ORDER BY t.route_id, t.trip_headsign
